competence_summary: Traverses the Neo4j Knowledge Graph to compute upstream and downstream ripple impacts, architectural dependencies, and delivery milestone blast radius when a component or requirement changes or fails.
reasoning_heuristics: Step 1: Identify root entity (e.g. REQ-004 Passive Keyless Entry or proximity_controller.py).
Step 2: Delegate to requirement_agent to execute Cypher queries in Neo4j traversing (:Requirement)-[:PARENT_OF|CHILD_OF|CONSTRAINS|MITIGATES_RISK_OF|VARIANT_DIVERGENCE_OF*1..3]->().
Step 3: Extract affected downstream features, dependent microservices, hardware interfaces, and test suites.
Step 4: Cross-reference with delivery milestones (e.g. Milestone Alpha - Golden Run) to compute delivery risk score.
Step 5: Score the blast radius: Low (< 2 downstream nodes), Medium (2-5 nodes), High (5-10 nodes), Critical (> 10 nodes or critical path milestone affected).

candidate_agents.delegation_goal: Query Neo4j knowledge graph for deep dependency traversal.
Identify other open defects touching the same dependency cluster.

input_guardrails: Entity identifier must exist in Neo4j Knowledge Graph.
Traversal depth must be bounded between 1 and 4 to prevent cycle explosions.
safety_guardrails: PM.ai must NOT assume dependencies are resolved without verifying verified status in KG.

pass_conditions: Dependency subgraph extracted with clear directionality.
Milestone blast radius scored with concrete risk rating.
